graph_and_boundary_policy.portable_runtime: One Effect4.0.1 module identity, no declared dependencies, React/native SDK/Node builtin/filesystem/network/crypto/DOM/process imports excluded from portable exported source and emitted artifact. Native adapters and Rust reference code stay outside candidate runtime graph.
graph_and_boundary_policy.development_tools: Node-only tsc7 Go compiler and esbuild Go bundler stay out of exported portable runtime. No test-framework package: builtin Node JS test runner plus Effect testing Layers. D01 prohibits Rust-backed helpers/addons in development/test/build/generation/release as well as runtime; prebuilt binaries are not exempt. Node runs compiled .js/.mjs, avoiding native .ts stripping paths. Audit implementation language of actual selected native binary graph before accepting no-Rust proof.
graph_and_boundary_policy.optional_packages: Keep TypeScript7/esbuild optional OS/CPU binary package resolution; do not omit optional globally or add all platform packages directly. All versions/integrities locked component-locally and verified for selected host; no Rollup/Rust platform package is selected.
graph_and_boundary_policy.optional_peers: Selected npm application/development package graph declares no extra test-framework peer dependencies; rejected Vitest/Vite metadata does not authorize installing optional UI/browser/style/tool peers.
graph_and_boundary_policy.rejected_candidates: Vitest5.0.3/@effect/vitest4.0.1 peers are mutually compatible by metadata but require Vite. Vite7.3.7 brings Rollup native Rust parser; Vite8.3.3 brings Rolldown/LightningCSS Rust binaries. Reject both for D01 final portable test gate rather than exempt test-only addons. Their exact metadata remains separate historical decision evidence, not selected dependencies.

boundary_check_plan.typescript: Run local pinned tsc CLI with strict:true, noEmit typecheck/declarations as needed; no legacy TS compiler API or language-service plugins. Keep TypeScript6/unstable AST packages absent unless a separately reviewed need arises.
boundary_check_plan.artifact_graph: Use pinned esbuild bundle with platform:neutral, explicit target/format and metafile; resolve all source modules, reject unknown externals and all Node/platform imports; check emitted graph includes only approved runtime modules.
boundary_check_plan.globals: Portable tsconfig types:[], ES-only lib (no DOM or Node ambient globals) plus fail-closed source import/export/dynamic-import and forbidden-global inspections; neutral bundle/metafile closes runtime dependency graph. Regex alone is not complete: test computed/aliased/dynamic boundary access and select a reviewed pure-JS parser only if required. Node types exist only for test/host tooling, never portable source config.
boundary_check_plan.identity: Bundler graph verifies one Effect and one contract module instance per VM; native Metro/package resolution separate host gate.
boundary_check_plan.test_execution: Compile TypeScript tests with pinned esbuild (platform:node), or author .mjs tests against built portable JS. Execute exact Node24.21.0 node --test on explicit compiled JS test paths. Do not call node directly on .ts and do not add TS stripping/loaders implemented with Rust.
boundary_check_plan.module_specifiers: Source TypeScript uses ESM .js import specifiers with normal TypeScript/esbuild emit into ignored component-scoped dist; both built package consumers and builtin test runner consume JS. No .ts runtime loader.

reproducibility_plan: TS-FOUNDATION creates scoped package.json and lockfile with exact selected direct versions, npm@11.19.0, Node24.21.0 runtime identity; resolves all range dependencies into exact lock entries including tarball integrities and optional platform graph.

Use official pinned Node archive and published SHASUMS; verify archive hash and signed checksum provenance. Reject version mismatch before npm install/ci. Do not use npx or latest aliases to download tools implicitly.
Generate lock under selected npm, record raw package-lock SHA256 and all licenses/engines/peers. Existing snapshot is package metadata selection, not a realized or verified lock.

Fresh clean exact Node24/npm install with npm ci, engine-strict and default peer resolution; review required esbuild installation script/platform package loading explicitly. No new root dependency framework. Reject every Rust-backed helper/addon across dev/test/build as D01 requires.

Build tests as JS through esbuild/tsc and run builtin node:test plus node:assert/strict against compiled candidate exports. Run virtual clock, interruption, typed failure/resource cleanup cases with Effect testing Layers; qualify these APIs on exact Node/Effect before accepting the first slice.

Run scoped typecheck/test/build/boundary/self-test and metadata-derived negative boundary vectors with installed tools; compare built bytes/metafile/hash across two clean builds and check no React/native/Rust/runtime builtin imports.
Qualify macOS-arm64 development first; Linux-x64 and Windows-x64/arm64 tool/runtime lanes remain separate receipts. Optional binary metadata selection is not cross-platform execution proof.

Native Release bundles, Hermes/RN/web/macOS globals, license/privacy/flavor exclusion and F-Droid reproducibility have separate F03/F06 admission evidence. Keep all dev package binaries out of mobile/store/customer runtime artifacts.
limitations: No package install, lockfile creation, compiler API execution, runtime self-test, bundle graph or product test occurred.
All exact package metadata fetched from public npm; dist integrity is published metadata and tarballs were not downloaded/verified. Node checksum entries fetched; archives/signatures not verified.
Stable versions satisfy documented/declared ranges; semantic/runtime compatibility remains successor execution evidence.
Node release index dates2026-09-07 versus blog heading2026-09-08; version/npm selected from exact distribution index, no date used for compatibility.
No pin accepts native-host, deployed-service, store-flavor or Rust retirement qualification.

Rejected Vitest/Vite/Rollup metadata is historical candidate evidence only; no accepted package graph may include it. The exact installed optional Go-binary graph and absence of Rust helpers still need lock/install/artifact proof.
reconsideration_trigger: A selected package fails install/engine/peer/type/runtime/bundle checks, optional platform support is absent, required API is unstable/incompatible, relevant policy/support/security changes, or another exact runtime graph is proposed; preserve current authorities and update technical selection with review.
rollback: Revert this decision and receipt only; production Rust/native/public launchers and frozen contracts remain authoritative.

scripts.dev: concurrently -kc green,blue 'nodemon --watch rust -e rs --exec "npm run build:wasm"' 'vitepress dev docs'
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:all
scripts.build: concurrently -c green,blue "npm run build:wasm" "npm:build:ast-converters" && concurrently -c green,blue "npm run build:napi -- --release" "npm:build:js" && npm run build:copy-native
scripts.prepare: husky && npm run prepare:patch && node scripts/check-release.js || npm run build:prepare
scripts.test:cjs: npm run build:cjs && npm run test:only
scripts.lint:rust: cd rust && cargo fmt && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty
scripts.test:leak: npm install --no-save weak-napi@2.0.2 && npm run test:leak:only
scripts.update:js: npm run build:js && npm run build:copy-native
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build rust/bindings_wasm --out-dir ../../wasm --target web --no-pack && shx rm wasm/.gitignore
scripts.update:napi: npm run build:napi && npm run build:copy-native
scripts.release:docs: git fetch --update-head-ok origin master:master && git branch --force documentation-published master && git push origin documentation-published
scripts.build:prepare: concurrently -c green,blue "npm run build:napi -- --release" "npm:build:js:node" && npm run build:copy-native
scripts.build:bootstrap: shx mv dist dist-build && node dist-build/bin/rollup --config rollup.config.ts --configPlugin typescript --forceExit && shx rm -rf dist-build
scripts.build:wasm:node: wasm-pack build rust/bindings_wasm --out-dir ../../wasm-node --target nodejs --no-pack && shx rm wasm-node/.gitignore
scripts.lint:rust:nofix: cd rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy
scripts.test:typescript: shx rm -rf test/typescript/dist && shx cp -r dist test/typescript/ && tsc --noEmit -p test/typescript && tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p scripts && vue-tsc --noEmit -p docs
scripts.build:copy-native: shx mkdir -p dist && shx cp rollup.*.node dist/
scripts.test:only:coverage: node scripts/run-with-coverage-environment.js nyc --reporter lcovonly --reporter html mocha test/test.js
scripts.build:bootstrap:cjs: shx mv dist dist-build && node dist-build/bin/rollup --config rollup.config.ts --configPlugin typescript --configTest --forceExit && shx rm -rf dist-build
scripts.build:napi:coverage: bash -c 'coverage_env="$(cd rust && cargo llvm-cov show-env --sh)" && eval "$coverage_env" && (cd rust && cargo llvm-cov clean --workspace) && npm run build:napi'
